name: buyer-questions
description: Builds the question set to measure before you measure whether AI assistants and search recommend a company. Starts from buyer calls and buyer phrasing, checks what assistants already answer, has an independent reviewer check the set, freezes it, and writes a coverage map of which page answers each question. Use when asked to build a question set, pick prompts to track, find what buyers ask, plan AI answer or search coverage, or prepare input for a measurement.
